description: The discussions about a brand heating up RIGHT NOW: posts of the last window that mention one of its keywords and whose comments grew by delta in the last hours (or were born loud), each with title, url, author, comments_from/to, delta, hours, alerted_at. The answer to 'where should I comment today': hand the user the biggest deltas with their links and a proposed comment. Never post the comment yourself.

hours.description: The span the comments grew in (default 8).

networks.description: reddit, quora, x, instagram, tiktok, bluesky (default: all).

window.description: How far back a post may be, in hours (default 24).

name: viralhunt_brand_hot
